Record notes

Ten Mac workflows for recovery, verified copies, storage catalogs and memory diagnosis.

Version 0.3.2 includes 10 complete skill procedures. Complete original methods and shell helpers; receiving-host storage roles require configuration.

Requirements: macOS; Host terminal or computer-use tools.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add mac-ops-toolkit@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from fa4f68d5883a99971983ed9a7d874bc6e8993ec6. SHA-256: 89fe5b55b9c0530a626bf15f2a2b9cfb68297a22b183251a563365ff50fc06c9.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
